notes.title: 💃 TU-LU-LU LU-LU-LU 🎶
notes.notes:
Calling all WOOHP agents!

We’ve got several reports that criminal activity has been increasing in Singapore.

[h2]Prepare to fight crime with style in [i]Totally Spies! - Cyber Mission[/i], out on [b]October 31st[/b]![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030984/f4e8868a17515182e4bbcfca4e4d5d9d38231952.png[/img]

The [b]dazzling trio from Beverly Hills[/b] —Sam, Clover, and Alex— [b]is back[/b] and they are ready to light up the vibrant streets of Singapore with their spy skills! From the bustling streets of Singapore to AYIA University, embark on an [b]action-packed adventure[/b] as you explore all the futuristic spots of the town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030984/0524841c9e1d23550cf6e22dbe8f90d454a2b965.jpg[/img]

But buckle up! As the Spies settle into their new lives, a mysterious menace has emerged to spread chaos and is extending its influence, weaving its presence through the city streets.

With WOOHP on high alert, it's time for our favorite Spies to dive into action! Step into the shoes of the iconic team and be ready for thrilling missions with timeless fashionable gadgets! Take on new villains, go undercover and neutralize the imminent looming over the town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030984/edd4f042d46eaa48070db3b090ff4fb3969bcb73.jpg[/img]

🧭 [b]SECRET EXPLORATION[/b] - Take time to explore the city and its various locations. From the Port to the Bubble Spy Café and the famous gardens by the bay, discover dozens of essential collectibles for your missions! But remember, wherever you are, you never know when you’ll get Woohped...

🎭 [b]TOTALLY INCOGNITO[/b] - Master the art of infiltration by solving puzzles, collecting items, and remain discreet to avoid being spotted! The mission’s success is at stake.

💄 [b]STYLISH GADGETS[/b] - Save Singapore in style with an array of high-tech gadgets. From the iconic Compowder to the sleek laser lipstick, each gadget interacts with the environment, outwit enemies, and overcome obstacles in your path.

🤝 [b]STRENGTH IN UNITY[/b] - Play as your favorite spy and join forces with up to 2 friends in local multiplayer mode! Cooperation is key for overcoming challenges and progressing through the missions, as each spy has her unique strength and special gadgets.

📺 [b]JUST LIKE IN THE SERIES[/b] - Experience an adventure just as if you were in a [i]Totally Spies![/i] episode! Immerse yourself in an original story set in the new Season 7 and reunite with all your favorite characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030984/d7d84085dec1c8b2496966124776203155472213.jpg[/img]

[h2]Only you can save the world![/h2]
